highlights: AI agent technology is rapidly advancing, with new APIs enabling deep research and self-correcting agents improving reliability in real-world applications.

Significant strides in model efficiency and specialized applications are evident through faster vision-language models and the release of open-weight models for robot control and critical decision-making.

Major AI companies like OpenAI and Google continue to expand their market reach, introduce new model tiers, and foster global developer communities through strategic partnerships and educational initiatives.

agents.title: Exa Launches Agent Ultra: Subagent Swarm API for Deep Research
agents.summary: Exa's new Agent Ultra API coordinates subagents across thousands of sources for superior list building and entity enrichment, outperforming leading models like Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra on research benchmarks.

agents.title: Perplexity Trains Computer Agent on Real Mistakes with Self-Distillation
agents.summary: Perplexity improved its Computer Agent by training on real user sessions, including failures, using a novel hint-guided self-distillation method that significantly reduced tool-call failures by 21.2%.

agents.title: Ringg's AI Agents Resolve 65% of Customer Calls with OpenAI Models
agents.summary: Ringg leverages OpenAI's GPT-5.6 to power multilingual AI agents, effectively resolving up to 65% of customer calls across various channels at 90% less cost compared to GPT-4.1.

models.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-VL-3B-DSpark: 3.13x Faster Vision-Language Model with Speculative Decoding
models.summary: Liquid AI's new LFM2.5-VL-3B-DSpark model integrates speculative decoding, achieving up to 3.13x faster decoding for vision-language tasks with identical output quality, and is supported in popular inference frameworks like llama.cpp.

models.title: OpenAI Introduces GPT-6 Sol and Luna for Frontier Intelligence
models.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Sol and Luna, two new frontier models offering varying balances of capability and cost to bring advanced intelligence to a wider range of everyday applications.

models.title: Black Forest Labs Releases FLUX 3 Action: 7B Open-Weights World Action Model for Robotics
models.summary: Black Forest Labs launched FLUX 3 Action, a 7B open-weights World Action Model (WAM) for robot control, which interprets camera frames and robot state to predict future actions and video, topping the RoboLab-120 benchmark.

tools.title: Hugging Face Transformers Library Now Runs llama.cpp Quants
tools.summary: The Hugging Face Transformers library now directly supports `llama.cpp` quantized models, significantly expanding efficiency options for developers deploying LLMs on various hardware.

tools.title: Better Prompt Caching for GPT-6 Reduces Latency and Costs
tools.summary: GPT-6 now features improved prompt caching with higher hit rates, new diagnostics, and explicit controls, enabling developers to reduce latency and operational costs for API calls.

tools.title: AugLy for End-to-End Multimodal Data Augmentation and Adversarial Robustness Benchmark
tools.summary: AugLy provides a comprehensive framework for multimodal data augmentation and adversarial robustness benchmarking across images, text, audio, and PyTorch datasets, crucial for developing robust AI systems.

companies.title: OpenAI Introduces GPT-6 Sol and Luna and Demonstrates Broad Enterprise Impact
companies.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-6 Sol and Luna, new frontier models designed to balance capability and cost, alongside various enterprise successes demonstrating their models' impact across industries from fleet management to legal and media.

companies.title: Google Expands Global AI Reach with Beam Program and UN Data Commons Platform
companies.summary: Google is expanding its Beam program to five new countries and partnered with the UN to launch the UN System Data Commons, making global statistics more accessible and searchable, demonstrating a commitment to global AI infrastructure and public good.

companies.title: Hugging Face Welcomes oMLX Creator Jun Kim to Support MLX Community
companies.summary: Hugging Face has brought on Jun Kim, the creator of oMLX, to bolster support for the MLX community, signaling a strategic investment in open-source machine learning frameworks and developer enablement.

learning.title: Coding Guide to TypeSafe AI Jev: Typed Decisions and Speculative Fan-Out with System One Models
learning.summary: This guide offers a complete tutorial for TypeSafe AI's Jev, a System One model, detailing its Python SDK for structured judgments, speculative fan-out, and confidence-gated routing in production AI workflows.

learning.title: Grab and OpenAI Launch 'GO Forward with AI' to Upskill Southeast Asia
learning.summary: OpenAI and Grab have partnered to launch 'GO Forward with AI,' a regional program aimed at equipping 30,000 partners across Southeast Asia with practical AI skills, fostering local AI talent.

learning.title: DevFest 2026 Returns to Focus on Agentic AI Development
learning.summary: Google's DevFest 2026 returns with over 800 global events, providing developers with opportunities to connect, build, secure, and scale their projects, with a strong focus on the emerging agentic AI era.
